snippet.title: UDC Super Cop Interactive Coin-op Kiddie Ride
snippet.description:
UDC presents our exciting 'Super Cop' Police car kiddie ride with seating for 2, whether children, or one child and an adult.

Catch critters and score points in this superb kiddie ride that includes a full interactive cartoon style 3D driving game, designed especially for younger players. Displayed on the integrated 19" flat screen, with electronic sounds and music through the speaker system.

The ride steering wheel acts as the controller for the car in the video game, along with the accelerator pedal.

Styled in vibrant colours with super bright LED lighting.

Operator adjustable price of play via multi-coin mechanism and adjustable ride time.

In the interests of safety children must be supervised whilst using the ride.

For more information see the UDC website here: 

https://www.udc.co.uk/super-cop-kiddie-ride



Music by Teknoaxe.com used under CC 4.0 Creative Commons Attribution Licence.
